source: 19 Texas Administrative Code §74.4 (English Language Proficiency Standards), via law.cornell.edu

items.text: use prior knowledge and experiences to understand meanings in English
items.iwill: I will use prior knowledge and experiences to understand meanings in English.

items.text: monitor oral and written language production and employ self-corrective techniques or other resources
items.iwill: I will monitor oral and written language production and employ self-corrective techniques or other resources.

items.text: use strategic learning techniques such as concept mapping, drawing, memorizing, comparing, contrasting, and reviewing to acquire basic and grade-level vocabulary
items.iwill: I will use strategic learning techniques such as concept mapping, drawing, memorizing, comparing, contrasting, and reviewing to acquire basic and grade-level vocabulary.

items.text: speak using learning strategies such as requesting assistance, employing non-verbal cues, and using synonyms and circumlocution (conveying ideas by defining or describing when exact English words are not known)
items.iwill: I will speak using learning strategies such as requesting assistance, employing non-verbal cues, and using synonyms and circumlocution (conveying ideas by defining or describing when exact English words are not known).

items.text: internalize new basic and academic language by using and reusing it in meaningful ways in speaking and writing activities that build concept and language attainment
items.iwill: I will internalize new basic and academic language by using and reusing it in meaningful ways in speaking and writing activities that build concept and language attainment.

items.text: use accessible language and learn new and essential language in the process
items.iwill: I will use accessible language and learn new and essential language in the process.

items.text: demonstrate an increasing ability to distinguish between formal and informal English and an increasing knowledge of when to use each one commensurate with grade-level learning expectations
items.iwill: I will demonstrate an increasing ability to distinguish between formal and informal English and an increasing knowledge of when to use each one commensurate with grade-level learning expectations.

items.text: develop and expand repertoire of learning strategies such as reasoning inductively or deductively, looking for patterns in language, and analyzing sayings and expressions commensurate with grade-level learning expectations
items.iwill: I will develop and expand repertoire of learning strategies such as reasoning inductively or deductively, looking for patterns in language, and analyzing sayings and expressions commensurate with grade-level learning expectations.

items.text: distinguish sounds and intonation patterns of English with increasing ease
items.iwill: I will distinguish sounds and intonation patterns of English with increasing ease.

items.text: recognize elements of the English sound system in newly acquired vocabulary such as long and short vowels, silent letters, and consonant clusters
items.iwill: I will recognize elements of the English sound system in newly acquired vocabulary such as long and short vowels, silent letters, and consonant clusters.

items.text: learn new language structures, expressions, and basic and academic vocabulary heard during classroom instruction and interactions
items.iwill: I will learn new language structures, expressions, and basic and academic vocabulary heard during classroom instruction and interactions.

items.text: monitor understanding of spoken language during classroom instruction and interactions and seek clarification as needed
items.iwill: I will monitor understanding of spoken language during classroom instruction and interactions and seek clarification as needed.

items.text: use visual, contextual, and linguistic support to enhance and confirm understanding of increasingly complex and elaborated spoken language
items.iwill: I will use visual, contextual, and linguistic support to enhance and confirm understanding of increasingly complex and elaborated spoken language.

items.text: listen to and derive meaning from a variety of media such as audio tape, video, DVD, and CD ROM to build and reinforce concept and language attainment
items.iwill: I will listen to and derive meaning from a variety of media such as audio tape, video, DVD, and CD ROM to build and reinforce concept and language attainment.

items.text: understand the general meaning, main points, and important details of spoken language ranging from situations in which topics, language, and contexts are familiar to unfamiliar
items.iwill: I will understand the general meaning, main points, and important details of spoken language ranging from situations in which topics, language, and contexts are familiar to unfamiliar.

items.text: understand implicit ideas and information in increasingly complex spoken language commensurate with grade-level learning expectations
items.iwill: I will understand implicit ideas and information in increasingly complex spoken language commensurate with grade-level learning expectations.

items.text: demonstrate listening comprehension of increasingly complex spoken English by following directions, retelling or summarizing spoken messages, responding to questions and requests, collaborating with peers, and taking notes commensurate with content and grade-level needs
items.iwill: I will demonstrate listening comprehension of increasingly complex spoken English by following directions, retelling or summarizing spoken messages, responding to questions and requests, collaborating with peers, and taking notes commensurate with content and grade-level needs.

items.text: practice producing sounds of newly acquired vocabulary such as long and short vowels, silent letters, and consonant clusters to pronounce English words in a manner that is increasingly comprehensible
items.iwill: I will practice producing sounds of newly acquired vocabulary such as long and short vowels, silent letters, and consonant clusters to pronounce English words in a manner that is increasingly comprehensible.

items.text: expand and internalize initial English vocabulary by learning and using high-frequency English words necessary for identifying and describing people, places, and objects, by retelling simple stories and basic information represented or supported by pictures, and by learning and using routine language needed for classroom communication
items.iwill: I will expand and internalize initial English vocabulary by learning and using high-frequency English words necessary for identifying and describing people, places, and objects, by retelling simple stories and basic information represented or supported by pictures, and by learning and using routine language needed for classroom communication.

items.text: speak using a variety of grammatical structures, sentence lengths, sentence types, and connecting words with increasing accuracy and ease as more English is acquired
items.iwill: I will speak using a variety of grammatical structures, sentence lengths, sentence types, and connecting words with increasing accuracy and ease as more English is acquired.

items.text: speak using grade-level content area vocabulary in context to internalize new English words and build academic language proficiency
items.iwill: I will speak using grade-level content area vocabulary in context to internalize new English words and build academic language proficiency.

items.text: share information in cooperative learning interactions
items.iwill: I will share information in cooperative learning interactions.

items.text: ask and give information ranging from using a very limited bank of high-frequency, high-need, concrete vocabulary, including key words and expressions needed for basic communication in academic and social contexts, to using abstract and content-based vocabulary during extended speaking assignments
items.iwill: I will ask and give information ranging from using a very limited bank of high-frequency, high-need, concrete vocabulary, including key words and expressions needed for basic communication in academic and social contexts, to using abstract and content-based vocabulary during extended speaking assignments.

items.text: express opinions, ideas, and feelings ranging from communicating single words and short phrases to participating in extended discussions on a variety of social and grade-appropriate academic topics
items.iwill: I will express opinions, ideas, and feelings ranging from communicating single words and short phrases to participating in extended discussions on a variety of social and grade-appropriate academic topics.

items.text: narrate, describe, and explain with increasing specificity and detail as more English is acquired
items.iwill: I will narrate, describe, and explain with increasing specificity and detail as more English is acquired.

items.text: adapt spoken language appropriately for formal and informal purposes
items.iwill: I will adapt spoken language appropriately for formal and informal purposes.

items.text: respond orally to information presented in a wide variety of print, electronic, audio, and visual media to build and reinforce concept and language attainment
items.iwill: I will respond orally to information presented in a wide variety of print, electronic, audio, and visual media to build and reinforce concept and language attainment.

items.text: learn relationships between sounds and letters of the English language and decode (sound out) words using a combination of skills such as recognizing sound-letter relationships and identifying cognates, affixes, roots, and base words
items.iwill: I will learn relationships between sounds and letters of the English language and decode (sound out) words using a combination of skills such as recognizing sound-letter relationships and identifying cognates, affixes, roots, and base words.

items.text: recognize directionality of English reading such as left to right and top to bottom
items.iwill: I will recognize directionality of English reading such as left to right and top to bottom.

items.text: develop basic sight vocabulary, derive meaning of environmental print, and comprehend English vocabulary and language structures used routinely in written classroom materials
items.iwill: I will develop basic sight vocabulary, derive meaning of environmental print, and comprehend English vocabulary and language structures used routinely in written classroom materials.

items.text: use prereading supports such as graphic organizers, illustrations, and pretaught topic-related vocabulary and other prereading activities to enhance comprehension of written text
items.iwill: I will use prereading supports such as graphic organizers, illustrations, and pretaught topic-related vocabulary and other prereading activities to enhance comprehension of written text.

items.text: read linguistically accommodated content area material with a decreasing need for linguistic accommodations as more English is learned
items.iwill: I will read linguistically accommodated content area material with a decreasing need for linguistic accommodations as more English is learned.

items.text: use visual and contextual support and support from peers and teachers to read grade-appropriate content area text, enhance and confirm understanding, and develop vocabulary, grasp of language structures, and background knowledge needed to comprehend increasingly challenging language
items.iwill: I will use visual and contextual support and support from peers and teachers to read grade-appropriate content area text, enhance and confirm understanding, and develop vocabulary, grasp of language structures, and background knowledge needed to comprehend increasingly challenging language.

items.text: demonstrate comprehension of increasingly complex English by participating in shared reading, retelling or summarizing material, responding to questions, and taking notes commensurate with content area and grade level needs
items.iwill: I will demonstrate comprehension of increasingly complex English by participating in shared reading, retelling or summarizing material, responding to questions, and taking notes commensurate with content area and grade level needs.

items.text: read silently with increasing ease and comprehension for longer periods
items.iwill: I will read silently with increasing ease and comprehension for longer periods.

items.text: demonstrate English comprehension and expand reading skills by employing basic reading skills such as demonstrating understanding of supporting ideas and details in text and graphic sources, summarizing text, and distinguishing main ideas from details commensurate with content area needs
items.iwill: I will demonstrate English comprehension and expand reading skills by employing basic reading skills such as demonstrating understanding of supporting ideas and details in text and graphic sources, summarizing text, and distinguishing main ideas from details commensurate with content area needs.

items.text: demonstrate English comprehension and expand reading skills by employing inferential skills such as predicting, making connections between ideas, drawing inferences and conclusions from text and graphic sources, and finding supporting text evidence commensurate with content area needs
items.iwill: I will demonstrate English comprehension and expand reading skills by employing inferential skills such as predicting, making connections between ideas, drawing inferences and conclusions from text and graphic sources, and finding supporting text evidence commensurate with content area needs.

items.text: demonstrate English comprehension and expand reading skills by employing analytical skills such as evaluating written information and performing critical analyses commensurate with content area and grade-level needs
items.iwill: I will demonstrate English comprehension and expand reading skills by employing analytical skills such as evaluating written information and performing critical analyses commensurate with content area and grade-level needs.

items.text: learn relationships between sounds and letters of the English language to represent sounds when writing in English
items.iwill: I will learn relationships between sounds and letters of the English language to represent sounds when writing in English.

items.text: write using newly acquired basic vocabulary and content-based grade-level vocabulary
items.iwill: I will write using newly acquired basic vocabulary and content-based grade-level vocabulary.

items.text: spell familiar English words with increasing accuracy, and employ English spelling patterns and rules with increasing accuracy as more English is acquired
items.iwill: I will spell familiar English words with increasing accuracy, and employ English spelling patterns and rules with increasing accuracy as more English is acquired.

items.text: edit writing for standard grammar and usage, including subject-verb agreement, pronoun agreement, and appropriate verb tenses commensurate with grade-level expectations as more English is acquired
items.iwill: I will edit writing for standard grammar and usage, including subject-verb agreement, pronoun agreement, and appropriate verb tenses commensurate with grade-level expectations as more English is acquired.

items.text: employ increasingly complex grammatical structures in content area writing commensurate with grade-level expectations, such as:
items.iwill: I will employ increasingly complex grammatical structures in content area writing commensurate with grade-level expectations, such as:.

items.text: write using a variety of grade-appropriate sentence lengths, patterns, and connecting words to combine phrases, clauses, and sentences in increasingly accurate ways as more English is acquired
items.iwill: I will write using a variety of grade-appropriate sentence lengths, patterns, and connecting words to combine phrases, clauses, and sentences in increasingly accurate ways as more English is acquired.

items.text: narrate, describe, and explain with increasing specificity and detail to fulfill content area writing needs as more English is acquired
items.iwill: I will narrate, describe, and explain with increasing specificity and detail to fulfill content area writing needs as more English is acquired.
